notes: 2026-08-29 (branch `fix/turbo-global-dependencies`, off master a545a10d; no schema change) — TURBO'S CACHE KEY NOW INCLUDES THE LOCKFILE AND EVERY MANIFEST. `turbo.json` had no `globalDependencies` at all, so the entire global hash was ONE file: `.gitattributes`. Turbo hashes the dependency GRAPH it resolves out of `package-lock.json`, not the lockfile itself — measured on a545a10d by mutating one file at a time and diffing all 28 task hashes from `turbo run check-types lint test --dry=json`: a transitive dep's `version` change moved 28/28, but an `integrity` change (so a DIFFERENT tarball installs), a `dev`/`devOptional` metadata flip (the drift a foreign npm regenerates on a Dependabot lock PR), and whitespace ALL moved 0/28; root `package.json` moved 0/28 (so edits to the `verify` script's own definition invalidated nothing) and a workspace manifest moved only its OWN package's 3/28, never its dependents'. That is the third false-green mechanism found 2026-08-29 and the one behind #495's `18/18 CACHED, FULL TURBO, 4.6s` on a lockfile-only change (independently reproduced on a second branch whose replayed log reported 3130 api tests "passing" that never executed). Fix adds ONLY `globalDependencies: ["package-lock.json", "package.json", "apps/*/package.json", "packages/*/package.json"]` — the `tasks` block is byte-identical to master. All six mutations now move 28/28. ⚠️ `globalCacheInputs.files` resolves to exactly 11 entries (`.gitattributes` + the lock + the 9 git-tracked manifests) with ZERO node_modules paths — turbo hashes git-tracked files and node_modules is gitignored, so the walk cannot reach the 1896+ manifests under it; a bare `**/package.json` resolves to the identical 11 files, and the explicit list is kept only because it cannot be MISREAD as walking node_modules. TRADE-OFF, accepted: any dependency change now busts EVERY task's cache, so the first local run after a dep bump is cold by design (measured cold `npm run verify` = 12m15s, warm replay = seconds). ⚠️ CI is NOT affected and needs no matching change — it has no turbo cache whatsoever (no TURBO_TOKEN/TURBO_TEAM, no actions/cache of `.turbo`, fresh runner per job), so every CI run was already cold; the ONLY cache in ci.yml is `actions/setup-node`'s `cache: npm`, which that action already keys on package-lock.json. Cold-start cost lands on local runs and the pre-push hook only. || History in CHANGELOG.md (this directory).
